findings.problem: check_witness accepts impossible decoder histories as evidence of geometry/depth coverage. It checks true<=calls and depth<6 but not conservation across exhausted six-triangle walks and the final hit. The positive stand-in already emits calls2,true2,last1,depth0 (and cycles higher depths with the same calls), while a first-triangle hit needs one successful decoder read. Its exhausted example calls3,true2,last0,depth1 is also impossible for this fixed6-triangle mesh.
findings.failure_mechanism: Report counts/depth buckets are generated from the same inconsistent per-query fields, so report/transcript correspondence passes. This can manufacture apparent later-depth/exhaustion coverage without a possible original decoder call sequence. Actual18-driver-test success does not make those positive histories coherent.

A nonzero exhausted history with last0 must have depth5; no-call history retains depth0. Keep existing bounds/hit implications. Correct the positive collaborator to possible walks and add genuine actual-driver impossible-history controls with coherent report buckets, retaining healthy positives. This checks call history only, not a physical answer.
